cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Confess Around Them
cards.instruction: Use partial admissions to make a reciprocal confession feel like the only missing piece.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. I hid the first complaint letter. What happened to the second?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Exactly. I'm not asking you to stand in the spotlight alone.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then let's put our envelopes down in order.

mechanism: A orders partial admissions and physical letters so B's own withheld envelope becomes the missing part of a shared confession.
confusable: D132 asks exact facts without self-disclosure; D232 uses A's admissions as pressure toward reciprocal admission.
comparison: Concealed complaints and chronology differ from a failed meeting.
seedUse: Keep third-letter reveal; make A ask for its possession or destination rather than simply order envelopes.
